name: avunu/wordpress-sqlite-anywhere-driver-tools
description: Tooling for the bundled driver's test suites and coding standard. Deliberately separate from the plugin's own composer.json: upstream's suites use PHPUnit 8/9 APIs (the plugin's own tests run on PHPUnit 12), and WordPress Coding Standards needs PHP_CodeSniffer 3.x where nixpkgs ships 4.x. composition-c4 clones every locked package at eval time, so keeping these out of the root manifest also keeps `nix build .#zip` lean.
